metadata.description: Portable Claude Code skills for Unreal Engine 5.x development, one plugin per skill

plugins.name: ue-workstation
plugins.description: Claude Code harness for UE projects: safety hooks (editor ownership, no tree-rewriting git while the editor is open, clang-format), templates, doctor, safe-pull, clangd hygiene

plugins.name: code-analysis
plugins.description: Analyse, review and debug UE C++ to the root cause: engine signatures (engine-api), known-hazard index, log scan, agents code-scout / engine-reader / log-triage

plugins.name: ue-cpp-authoring
plugins.description: How to write C++ for UE 5.x: idioms, assertions and threading, validation, asset slots, modules, subsystems and data assets, widgets and CommonUI, refactoring, editor tool plugins

plugins.name: ue-build-test
plugins.description: Build and run UE automation tests without the editor window: incremental and full builds, Game/Shipping gate, test authoring, flaky-test quarantine

plugins.name: unreal-editor
plugins.description: Drive a live Unreal Editor with Epic's own tools: unreal-mcp toolsets and Python Remote Execution - launch, PIE, asset and level edits, screenshots, log checks, Live Coding, Python inspection of PIE

plugins.name: ue-content-gates
plugins.description: Offline UE content checks: .uasset headers, which assets use a C++ symbol, forbidden references, /Game paths in C++, cook verification

plugins.name: ue-gas
plugins.description: Gameplay Ability System in UE 5.x: feature cheatsheets, GAS code review checklist, mechanics reference (working digest + tranek's GASDocumentation) with 5.5+ corrections

plugins.name: ue-systems
plugins.description: UE 5.8 gameplay frameworks, one skill each: Enhanced Input, StateTree, PCG - setup, C++ and asset idioms, review checklist, traps verified against the engine source

plugins.name: ue-release
plugins.description: UE pre-release pass: project metadata, branding, debug code stripped from Shipping, bundled PSO cache, localization coverage, then the project's own packaging command

plugins.name: ue-perf
plugins.description: Profile a UE 5.x game with Unreal Insights without its window: capture a .utrace, export it headless, read a text digest - frame times and hitches, top timers per thread and GPU, worst frames broken down

plugins.name: devping
plugins.description: Pings to the phone from Claude Code windows through ntfy: a window that waits for an answer or has finished sends only its name and that kind; per-project topics, nothing written into the project

plugins.name: doc-tts
plugins.description: Voice markdown documents into MP3 with a local neural voice: Qwen3-TTS on a ComfyUI stand, a voice designed once from a written description and cloned for every document (Microsoft Edge TTS as a fallback)

plugins.name: md-doc-hygiene
plugins.description: Markdown/Obsidian docs: how to write a document people read (structure, summary, problems, open questions, table of contents) and form rules with checkers: list numbering, heading and block anchors, links, tables, tables of contents, repeated sentences; jargon and glossary checks driven by the project's own dictionaries

plugins.name: desk-utils
plugins.description: Windows desktop helpers: read/write the clipboard, capture the screen, print markdown/HTML to PDF via headless Chrome or Edge
